hello_subtitle: UI/UX sandbox. No database, mock API only. Dev builds only.
hello_i18n_desc: Default locale lives in project.inlang/settings.json; currency and time zone in src/lib/config.ts.
hello_api_desc: GET /api/hello returns fixed JSON with no database call. Its message is translated on the server.
savebar_discard_desc: All unsaved changes will be lost. This can't be undone.
savebar_leave_desc: You have unsaved changes. Leaving will discard them.
demo_savebar_desc: Edit a field and the bar slides in. Try Ctrl/⌘+S, Discard, the link below, and the browser's Back button.
demo_invalid_desc: Locks Save without hiding the bar.
demo_fail_desc: The changes stay unsaved and an error toast appears.
demo_form_desc: Example form state, held in a Draft.
demo_notify_desc: Send a digest when something changes.
demo_save_fail: Save failed. Your changes are still here.
demo_shell_desc: Placeholder page inside the shell. Try the sidebar, the breadcrumb, Ctrl/⌘+/ to search, Ctrl/⌘+B to collapse, and a phone-sized window.
demo_shell_slow: Reports load slowly on purpose, so you can see the top progress bar and the spinner on the row you clicked.
demo_shell_unlisted: This page isn't in the nav, so the breadcrumb is empty.
